item.title: University warns bus cuts risk forcing students to quit as 'lifeline' faces axe
item.author: heraldscotland.com
item.description: Stagecoach confirmed it received a letter from UHI Perth and that it will respond directly to it. The bus company - which was taken over by German investment group DWS Infrastructure in a £595 million deal in 2022 - stands by its statement issued last week in response to concerns about the proposed withdrawal of its X56 service.
